case.title: The star that smokes
case.hook: For months it shines steadily; then it vanishes by eight magnitudes, as if someone blew out a candle. It makes its own soot.

query.adql: SELECT source_id, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_over_error, pmra, pmdec, ruwe, phot_g_mean_mag, phot_bp_mean_mag, phot_rp_mean_mag, bp_rp, phot_variable_flag, teff_gspphot, distance_gspphot, non_single_star, DISTANCE(POINT(237.14339784473003,28.1567488479), POINT(ra,dec))*3600 AS sep_arcsec FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT(ra,dec), CIRCLE(237.14339784473003,28.1567488479,0.008333333333333333)) ORDER BY sep_arcsec

notes: rows_kept counts 6-month visits (W1 and W2), not exposures
observers (good points): FJQ:7416, ATE:5349, PXR:2031, SPP:1013, VOL:676, SGOR:541, DJED:458, TSCB:389, SXN:378, ROE:349, HMB:328, GOT:312
upper limits, discrepant (val=T) and non-standard bands are kept but flagged; visual estimates form their own series 'Vis.'
no ZTF source (target may be brighter than ZTF saturation, ~12.5 mag)
